card.name: Inside interleukin and similar names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word that is split partway, mostly the 'in' of interleukin before a hyphen and number, and 'os' in Aminosyn. Also seen in anecdotally and in Arabic names like 'Abd al-.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The 'in' ending of interleukin right before a hyphen and a number.

modes.label: Aminosyn products
modes.description: The 'os' in the brand name Aminosyn within IV nutrition product lists.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle pieces of rarer words such as anecdotally, itinerant, or the 'al' in Arabic names.
